specification.title: Specification URI
specification.description: The URI to the OpenApi specification file.

host.title: Host
host.description: The host to use for calling the REST service. Overrides the value found in the OpenAPI specification. The format is https://hostname:port.

basePath.title: Base Path
basePath.description: The API base path. Overrides the value present in the OpenAPI specification.

clientRequestValidation.title: Client Request Validation
clientRequestValidation.description: Whether to enable validation of the client request to check if the incoming request is valid according to the OpenAPI specification.
